question: Inside a real host turn, what does the llm/stream wrapper do with a chunk it did not expect, and can a repair still dispatch under a name the profile already owns?
contract_after_r69: remedy may only pass a chunk through, repair a proven fusion, or rethrow the original failure; it must not raise an error of its own

probe.homes: one isolated DSH_HOME per arm; nothing under ~/.dsh is written
probe.client: the installed headless CLI of DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 (plugins/plugin/dist and core/dist as packaged)
probe.neighbour: tests/fixtures/neighbour-bad-chunks — a plugin on llm/stream that yields the shapes the pi-ai adapter never produces
probe.provider: a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint that answers every request with one short text stream

arms.control: the neighbour only: the host outcome this stream would have without remedy
arms.new: this tree, which is the published 0.4.19 bytes

control.stderr_first: dsh: format v4 tool/result at seq 19 requires toolCallId matching its tool source

claims.p0053_a_chunk_whose_arguments_is_not_a_s: the 0.4.18 bytes ended the turn with "text.trim is not a function"; this tree reproduces the neighbour-only outcome
claims.p0053_a_finish_without_a_reason: the 0.4.18 bytes ended the turn with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind')"; this tree reproduces the neighbour-only outcome
claims.p0053_null_chunk: identical in all three arms: the host itself reads `type`, so this shape cannot attribute an author
claims.p0053_block_end_without_a_block: identical in all three arms: the host itself reads `block.type`, so this shape cannot attribute an author
claims.p0054_a_fused_fragment: the 0.4.18 bytes dispatched the repaired fragment under `remedy_unattributed`; this tree abandons the rescue and the turn carries the provider failure
claims.p0054_a_nameless_block_end: the 0.4.18 bytes dispatched a nameless call under `remedy_unattributed`; this tree keeps the original bytes and the host answers UNKNOWN_TOOL
claims.p0033_an_empty_identity_never_reaches_th: without the plugin the host cannot write the tool result (`format v4 tool/result at seq N requires toolCallId matching its tool source`, upstream #11151 / #10732); this tree completes the turn and the call leaves under the fallback name

not_proven: the shapes are synthesized by a neighbour plugin at the seam, not produced by the pi-ai adapter; the adapter that produces the measured incidents is dsh-llm-deepseek, which this harness does not drive
the provider is local and synthetic: one text stream per turn, one turn per run
`null` and a `block-end` with no `block` are non-discriminating here: the host fails with the same message in every arm, so no author can be attributed from the session
one machine, one profile shape, Windows; the same tree was run on Linux for the build and gates, not for these turns

verdict.p0053: verified — inside a real turn, two shapes the 0.4.18 bytes turned into remedy's own TypeError now reproduce the neighbour-only outcome
verdict.p0054: verified — inside a real turn, a profile that owns `remedy_unattributed` no longer receives the repaired fragment or the nameless call
